page.overview:
Who is Boss?

This page contains bosses that appear in the China Edition.

The Red Glozmore is a boss that only appears in China Edition and has 400 health points. It deals 10 health points for its regular attack. It has a red laser attack that deals double the damage that has been dealt to it.
